subject: finance
prompt_suffix: Render this as an XMind-style mind map diagram, as simple as possible. Keep layout clean and minimal. Use font family preference: Open Sans, Clear Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, Segoe UI Emoji, SF Pro, sans-serif.

images.prompt: A timeline diagram showing a bond's cash flows. The timeline starts at Year 0 (Bond Purchase) and extends to Year 5 (Maturity). At Year 1, 2, 3, 4, there are arrows pointing up labeled "Coupon Payment ($40)". At Year 5, there is an arrow pointing up labeled "Coupon Payment ($40) + Principal Repayment ($1,000)".

Render this as an XMind-style mind map diagram, as simple as possible. Keep layout clean and minimal. Use font family preference: Open Sans, Clear Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, Segoe UI Emoji, SF Pro, sans-serif.

Diagram must be fully contained within the canvas, centered, scaled down if necessary, with at least 10-15% safe margin on all sides. No text or shapes touching or crossing image boundaries.

images.prompt: A graph showing bond price on the y-axis and interest rate (yield) on the x-axis. The curve should be downward sloping and slightly convex. Two points on the curve should be marked, and a tangent line drawn at one point to illustrate duration as a linear approximation of price change, highlighting that the actual curve is not perfectly linear.
